criterion: For each sensory architecture choose by mean actual first B positive reward across the paired family interventions and all three discovery topologies, with physical contact and same-A signed receipt waveform in every world. The no-mirror voltage branch is the primary strict-sensory candidate. The opponent branch is a declared architectural reference.
endpoint: The actual contact immediately after the first rewarded B anchor; no query feedback is shown. Reports require both sign histories on at least 99% actual contact, exact A-waveform balance, same-world dual correctness, and hold/frozen-gain and scrambled-A contrasts.
learning: Only local Hebbian correlation of signed recall and experienced taste, decays typed context-gated weight vectors. Outer selection uses the actual observed physical query reward, verified equal to correctness in deterministic probe. No learned initialization across evaluated worlds.
